breaking.change: Renamed from alpha: how opaque a thing is is named opacity in every module. Same value, 0 to 1, default 1. An alpha left in place is no longer read, so the paint or the key is opaque.
breaking.fix: Rename alpha to opacity in each Paint ({ token: "ink", opacity: 0.5 }) and in each key of a mass template's keys.

breaking.change: Renamed from occludedAlpha, as Paint.opacity. Same value, default 0.25.

Renamed from lifetime: it is in ticks, and a time not in seconds says its unit in its name. Same value; 0 still shows pushed instances for their tick only. A lifetime left in place is no longer read, so spawned instances last one tick.
breaking.fix: Rename lifetime to lifetimeTicks in each og.ui.defineMass desc; leave every other lifetime (they are seconds).

breaking.change: Renamed from accel: it is in milliseconds. Same value; 0 is still 250 and negative none.
breaking.fix: Rename accel to accelMs in each og.ui.setVirtualCursor desc.

breaking.change: Renamed from og.ui.action: it answers a bool, the tick a UI action fires, where og.input.action answers an action's whole state (an object, always truthy in an if). og.ui.actionHeld keeps its name.
Renamed from pressed and released, the words og.input uses for the one tick a press goes down or comes up; down is still the state.
breaking.fix: Read justPressed and justReleased on og.ui.framePointer()'s answer.

breaking.change: Renamed from held: a press is down on the element. held means down for a holdMs, a long press, which a gesture reports as longPressed and longPress.

added.summary: The conventions guide gains the UI's lines: opacity names how opaque a thing is in every module, and the UI's pointer, gestures and actions use down, justPressed, justReleased and held as og.input does.

The test over every field of the API has no UI member left to rename and keeps two more names: a field named alpha or ending in Alpha is an opacity, and a bool named pressed or released is justPressed or justReleased. The UI's fields in ticks, radians and ratios carry their units (MassTemplateDesc.lifetimeTicks, GestureInfo.rotation, the opacities).
